bulkUpload.title: Import & update items
bulkUpload.instructions: Choose a CSV or text file to import. For a complete import, use the headers item, category, quantity, unit, notes in any order. Legacy file formats still work: cucumbers,10,kg or milk,Dairy. Review imported items before saving. To type one or several products manually, use Quick Add.
